module: Flowgraph node 'Get Mission Setup Data' (provider category). Exposes on its outputs the values of the mission setup modules (self.mgr.activity.setupModules): use of the player's original vehicle, chosen model/config, and traffic settings (active, previous traffic, amount, active amount, respawn rate).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: If an activity with setupModules exists, copies data.vehicles.* and data.traffic.* to the pins (booleans forced, default values '' or 0).
